We are looking for a new colleague to join our Routing Services team in the Cloud Networking Products division. We own the host routing software stack, overlay network and the networking configurations that enable our customers to run massive computing workloads in over 30 Akamai Cloud data centers. Partner with the best Join us in shaping the next generation of cloud computing. This role provides an opportunity to make a significant impact on Akamai's growing cloud offerings. You must have a passion to get things done quickly and get them done right. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for: Building the routing overlay and derivative products. Designing, implementing, reviewing, documenting, and testing high quality code and networking configurations in close collaboration with your team. Working closely with peers, and coordinating with teams globally as part of building new features, dealing with bugs or driving consensus on a technical solution. Do What You Love To be successful in this role you will: Have experience with mainstream programming languages, such as Go or C/C++. Have a strong familiarity with L3 networking: BGP, dynamic routing, and also experience with tunneling (if you know EVPN, VxLAN or SRv6, that is amazing). Have very good understanding of Linux networking internals. Have hands-on experience with containerization (e.g., Docker) and virtualization. Have hands-on experience with a large scale distributed systems and architecture. Have good communication skills, and experience in communicating with leadership and non-developer stakeholders. Be able to work productively with team members to identify and resolve issues in a collaborative manner. Be experienced in technical design, product specifications reviews, projects and backlog planning. Having Experience With The Following Is a Nice-to-have Open source routing daemon suites, such as FRR or gobgp, or with other BGP speakers. Cloud Computing - either as a user or an engineer. Observability using Prometheus, Grafana Infrastructure as Code: Ansible, Terraform Containerlab and CI/CD setups like Jenkins Providing guidance and mentoring to other developers or testers. Build your career at Akamai Our ability to shape digital life today relies on developing exceptional people like you. The kind that can turn impossible into possible. We’re doing everything we can to make Akamai a great place to work. A place where you can learn, grow and have a meaningful impact. With our company moving so fast, it’s important that you’re able to build new skills, explore new roles, and try out different opportunities. There are so many different ways to build your career at Akamai, and we want to support you as much as possible. We have all kinds of development opportunities available, from programs such as GROW and Mentoring, to internal events like the APEX Expo and tools such as Linkedin Learning, all to help you expand your knowledge and experience here. Learn more Not sure if this job is the right match for you or want to learn more about the job before you apply? Schedule a 15-minute exploratory call with the Recruiter and they would be happy to share more details.

review_candidates.title: Platform Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: i2 Group , a Harris Computer company , is seeking a Platform Software Engineer on a full-time, permanent, remote basis with a monthly requirement of attending the i2 Group offices in Cambridge. The Role The Platform team solves one of the harder problems in software delivery: getting the same product to work correctly on a developer's laptop, a cloud cluster, a multi-node on-premise deployment, and a fully air-gapped system. None of those environments are ones we control once deployed, and loose intent produces different results on each of them. The job is deciding precisely what has to be true everywhere, and then building it. Alongside customer-facing delivery, the team builds the internal platform capabilities that let our R&D teams self-serve infrastructure and software. It is our second priority and the area where our AI-first workflows have moved fastest. We are a small team, working closely with Architects, UX Designers, and Product Managers. We are looking for engineers who can define, design, and build platform capabilities, rather than simply maintain them. How We Work We are AI-first. The bottleneck has shifted from writing to thinking, the AI writes the code, you own the decisions that shape it. If you have worked this way before, you'll recognise the workflow immediately. If you haven't, it's a shift in how you think about your time. Your focus is on the decisions, not the code that expresses them.Deep expertise in a specific tool stack matters less than it once did. What counts is knowing what good looks like — enough domain awareness to write a meaningful spec, ask the right questions, and develop an instinct for where AI helps, where it misleads, and when not to trust it. Whether you come from an AI-first background or a platform engineering background, you are welcome here. The AI-first developer brings rigour and reasoning; the platform engineer brings domain knowledge and an instinct for what good looks like. Either way, we'll help you get there. What You'll Be Doing The precision described above is not a separate activity from delivery — it is how we deliver. In practice the role covers: Designing, building, and maintaining the software and tooling used to deploy, configure, and operate i2's products across desktop, single-box, on-premise, and cloud targets Building production-grade container images and the interfaces they expose to hosting platforms Owning the deployment and upgrade story for stateful distributed components, including recovery paths from shapes already shipped to customers Delivering releases to customers across diverse and often restricted environments, and supporting the upgrade paths from what is already in the field Developing internal platform capabilities that let R&D teams self-serve infrastructure and software Maintaining and improving CI/CD pipelines and internal developer tooling Instrumenting deployments and the delivery pipeline so that decisions are made on data Contributing to architectural decisions, validating that what gets built matches what was specified, and owning the quality of AI-generated output Owning the testing strategy for deployments What We're Looking For The things we care most about are the ones that are hardest to teach: a spec-first way of working, design thinking, and the judgement to know when something that looks right is not. Specifically You can take a vague requirement, interrogate it, record the decision and its trade-offs, and define the test that would prove it wrong You can decompose a system into components with clear responsibilities, decide where a boundary belongs, and be concrete about what crosses it and how it is authenticated You are AI-first or ready to commit to it — not just willing to try it alongside your existing workflow Cloud deployment and Infrastructure-as-Code — you have built deployments on a major cloud and understand the tooling You have the judgement to recognise when AI output is wrong — a plausible implementation that quietly violates a security invariant, or a port that looks correct and is not You are comfortable working in technologies and deployment topologies you have not encountered before, and you learn them quickly The Technical Depth We Look For Sits Alongside Those Traits, Not Above Them. We Want Experience In Platform Or Software Engineering In a Commercial Environment — Enough Exposure To Deployment And Operational Concerns To Write Meaningful Specs And Validate AI Output Against Them Experience shipping software to structurally different deployment targets; you understand why they differ, not just that they do Container technology: you have built and shipped production-grade images, not just run them locally Cloud deployment and Infrastructure-as-Code: you have worked with AWS and understand the tooling Application security: you understand trust boundaries, identity models, and secrets handling CI/CD pipelines: you have built and maintained them, not just consumed them You can work effectively with engineers, architects, and non-technical stakeholders The role may require UK national Security Check (SC) vetting; candidates must be eligible for and willing to undergo this if needed. Bachelor's degree in software engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience What You'll Work With These are the technologies you will be working with day to day: AI coding tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) as the primary development workflow AWS today, with Azure and Google Cloud planned Infrastructure as code: AWS CDK and CloudFormation CI/CD with CircleCI and internal developer tooling Docker and production image pipelines Deployment tooling for Windows and Linux, including desktop installer and packaging Apache Solr, ZooKeeper, DB2, SQL Server, Postgres Ansible for configuration management Python Helpful, But Not Required Kubernetes AWS or Azure certification in one or more disciplines FastAPI, React, or TypeScript, for internal developer tooling and portals About I2 Group i2 Group is the global leader in advanced visual analysis solutions. We empower analysts and investigators to discover, create, and disseminate actionable intelligence to combat threats including crime, terrorism, war, and fraud. Our software helps analysts transform data in real time, enabling customers to detect, disrupt, and defeat sophisticated threats across law enforcement, fraud and financial crime, military defence, and national security. Benefits Salary: £45,0000 - £65,000 25 days holiday + 5 Personal Days leave + bank holidays Private health and dentalcare Employee share options Annual Lifestyle Reward amounting £325 per annum/pro rata. Supporting Your Application Our recruitment process comprises interviews and, at times, a written exercise, an assessment day, and/or a presentation. As an equal opportunities employer, we want to do all we can to make this a positive experience for you. If your application progresses, please make us aware of any adjustments or additional support we can provide.

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer - DRC Human Resources for Health (HRH)
review_candidates.location: Kinshasa, Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
review_candidates.description: Position : Software Engineer Program: Improve Human Resources for Health (HRH) through Implementing a Digital Health Worker Information System (iHRIS) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) Location: Kinshasa, DRC (full-time, in-country) Duration: 25 months Please Note: Global Communities is considering only local candidates. This position is contingent upon award and donor approval. Start date will be determined upon award. Overview Global Communities champions community-led solutions to complex challenges at the intersection of global health, humanitarian assistance, sustainable development, and financial inclusion. Together with our subsidiary IntraHealth International, we bring local and global insights together to save lives, expand opportunity, and build resilient health systems. We are the developer and global steward of iHRIS, an open-source Human Resource Information System, used in more than 30 countries to manage over two million health worker records. Global Communities is seeking a full-time Software Engineer, based in Kinshasa, DRC, to support a new project to improve health workforce planning, management, equity, and payment integrity by establishing a government-owned, sustainable iHRIS. The project will support the Ministry of Public Health, Hygiene, and Social Welfare (MoH), the Agence Nationale d’Ingénierie Clinique (ANICNS), and other government stakeholders to design, implement, and institutionalize use of iHRIS in two provinces for improve health workforce decision making, interoperable with the national health worker payment system and other health worker registries, as a model for scaling nationwide. The Software Engineer will lead the technical implementation of iHRIS, including installation, configuration, customization, interoperability, testing, deployment, maintenance, and continued software development. The role will also provide technical support and build the capacity of central and provincial government users and administrators through training, mentorship, documentation, and knowledge transfer. The Software Engineer will work closely with the project team, government counterparts, technology partners, and Global Communities’ digital health team. This position will require regular travel to the two target provinces to support system development and capacity strengthening. Responsibilities The Software Engineer will lead the technical implementation of iHRIS, including customization, interoperability, deployment, maintenance, and knowledge transfer. The role will strengthen in-country capacity to administer, maintain, troubleshoot, and customize the system through formal training, hands-on mentorship, and clear technical documentation. Specific responsibilities include the following: Software Development Lead the design, development, configuration, and maintenance of digital health technologies required for project activities, ensuring that solutions align with approved requirements, technical architecture, security standards, and government priorities. Lead the design, development, testing, documentation, and maintenance of secure interoperability between iHRIS, the inclusive payments system, and other health worker registries, in coordination with the responsible system teams. Gather, document, prioritize, and validate functional and technical requirements with MoH and provincial stakeholders, end users, software engineers, partners, and program staff; translate approved requirements into user stories, specifications, and acceptance criteria; and communicate decisions and trade-offs across teams. Manage the software development lifecycle, including prototyping, configuration, customization, version control, code review, automated and user acceptance testing, release planning, deployment, rollback procedures, bug resolution, and continuous improvement. Write secure, maintainable, and efficient code using appropriate web technologies; conduct and participate in source code reviews; and optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability for low-bandwidth operating environments. Plan and support data migration, including source-data assessment, mapping, transformation, deduplication, validation, reconciliation, secure transfer, and remediation of data quality issues in collaboration with data owners. Establish and maintain development, testing, and production environments; implement monitoring, backup, recovery, and disaster-recovery procedures; document system configurations and dependencies; and support timely patching and upgrades to sustain system availability. Implement and document appropriate security and privacy safeguards, including role-based access controls, authentication, audit logging, encryption, vulnerability remediation, and secure handling of personally identifiable health workforce data in accordance with applicable government policies and approved project requirements. Maintain and communicate technical work plans, estimates, dependencies, decisions, risks, and mitigation actions; contribute to project reporting; and promptly escalate issues that could affect system quality, security, interoperability, budget, or delivery timelines. Capacity Strengthening Provide user and administrator training and support to government stakeholders at the provincial and central levels. Provide responsive technical support to users and administrators; troubleshoot and resolve incidents and recurring problems; document solutions in a shared knowledge base; track requests through closure; and escalate issues when specialized support is required. Assess training needs, develop and maintain role-specific curricula and job aids, facilitate practical training sessions, evaluate participant competency, and provide follow-up coaching to reinforce correct system use and administration. Build the capacity of designated government counterparts to administer, configure, maintain, troubleshoot, and support iHRIS through training, mentorship, documented standard operating procedures, and progressively transferred responsibilities. Client Management Cultivate effective working relationships with government counterparts, end users, implementation partners, and other key stakeholders, serving as a primary technical focal point for requirements, design decisions, implementation updates, risks, and issue resolution. Translate stakeholder needs, objectives, and operational workflows into feasible technical options, and work collaboratively to align system development with approved priorities, government policies, available resources, and the long-term sustainability of iHRIS. Facilitate regular feedback and review sessions with stakeholders, document decisions and unresolved issues, communicate implications for scope and timelines, and incorporate approved feedback into the product backlog and release plans. Qualifications Minimum qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering (or relevant field) with 5 years of relevant experience or Master’s degree with 3 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated experience providing technical support to digital health programs and providing technical support for health information systems Proven ability to build complex web applications using front-end JavaScript frameworks such as Vue.js, React, or Angular. Proven experience developing server-side applications and RESTful APIs with JavaScript (Node.js). At least 3 years of experience with SQL databases. At least 3 years of experience deploying, monitoring, securing, backing up, upgrading, and maintaining software on local Linux servers and on cloud platforms in low-bandwidth environments At least 3 years of experience collaborating with ministries of health or comparable public-sector institutions to analyze workflows, gather and validate requirements, support change management, and adapt software to operational needs. Demonstrated experience implementing data protection safeguards for systems containing sensitive personal information. Demonstrated experience applying agile software development practices, including backlog management, sprint planning, estimation, code review, testing, continuous integration, version control, and release management. Demonstrated project management and time management skills; must be highly organized and detail-oriented Demonstrated experience producing documentation and other resources such as training materials and user guides Written and spoken proficiency in French and English Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with the HL7 FHIR standard. 5+ years of full-stack JavaScript development with Node.js and Vue.js. Experience using issue tracking, source control, code review, documentation, and team collaboration tools such as Jira, Trello, GitHub, GitLab, or Slack. Demonstrated familiarity with the DRC health sector and experience working effectively with national and provincial government stakeholders and local technology partners. Global Communities’ Commitment Global Communities positively welcomes and seeks applications from all sections of society. We are committed to a work environment that respects the dignity and worth of everyone and offers equal opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. Global Communities holds strict safeguarding principles and has a zero-tolerance policy for conduct of sexual exploitation, abuse, and harassment. In the process of recruitment, selection, and appointment, Global Communities will conduct robust reference and background screening checks, including international vetting as a signatory of the Global Misconduct Disclosure Scheme, to ensure children and vulnerable adults are safeguarded and abuse is prevented. The incumbent is required to carry out their duties in accordance with Global Communities’ Safeguarding policy and Standards of Conduct.

review_candidates.title: Data Engineer
review_candidates.description: Wat ga je doen? Wil jij het werk van zorgprofessionals, beleidsadviseurs en bestuurders in de acute zorg makkelijker maken? Wil jij pionier zijn in een datagedreven omgeving waar informatie de sleutel is tot betere zorg? Ben jij die gedreven professional die het dataplatform van NAZL helpt opbouwen, onderhouden en verbeteren? Sluit je dan aan als Data Engineer bij een team dat net als jij vol enthousiasme werkt aan innovatie en vooruitgang in de acute zorg. Bij Netwerk Acute Zorg Limburg (NAZL) groeit data uit tot een kernpijler voor datagedreven zorg. Als Data Engineer leg jij niet alleen de basis voor een betrouwbaar en schaalbaar dataplatform, maar zorgen jouw oplossingen ervoor dat zorgprofessionals en beleidsmakers kunnen vertrouwen op accurate, actuele en toegankelijke data. Jij maakt het verschil door: ✔️ Stabiele data-infrastructuur op te bouwen en te onderhouden, waar het hele netwerk op kan voortbouwen. ✔️ Data te verzamelen, combineren en beschikbaar te stellen voor ROAZ-beeld en landelijke bronnen, in samenwerking met alle ketenpartners. ✔️ Dashboards en rapportages te ondersteunen en mee te ontwikkelen, zodat data actiegericht wordt ingezet. ✔️ Een netwerk op te bouwen met andere data engineers bij zorgorganisaties in Limburg, om kennis te delen en samen te werken aan toekomstbestendige oplossingen. Jouw Verantwoordelijkheden Data-onderhoud & Platformbeheer Onderhouden en updaten van bestaande ETL-pijplijnen en datamodellen, om de betrouwbaarheid en efficiëntie van het dataplatform te waarborgen. Ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van SQL-query’s en datastructuren voor snelle, betrouwbare data-toegang. Ondersteunen bij het bouwen van Power BI-dashboards en rapportages, in samenwerking met analisten en eindgebruikers. Implementeren van datakwaliteitscontroles en -standaarden (o.a. validatie, lineage, metadata), met oog voor security-by-design en compliance (AVG, zorgspecifieke regelgeving). Data-integratie & Samenwerking Verzamelen en combineren van data uit diverse bronnen (o.a. ERP, zorgsystemen, CBS, Vektis, CRM) voor ROAZ-beelden en andere landelijke rapportages. Automatiseren van repetitieve taken (bijv. schema-updates, data-refreshes) om handmatig werk te verminderen. Samenwerken met IT, zorgprofessionals en externe partijen om datastromen veilig en efficiënt in te richten (o.a. in geïsoleerde omgevingen). Adviseren over databeheer en -governance, met aandacht voor schaalbaarheid en toekomstbestendigheid. Meedenken over standaarden en automatisering, om het dataplatform toekomstproof te maken. Hoe ziet je werkomgeving eruit? Je gaat aan de slag binnen het Netwerk Acute Zorg Limburg (NAZL), een regionaal netwerk waarin zorgorganisaties en professionals samenwerken aan een goed georganiseerde en toekomstbestendige acute zorg in Limburg. Data en informatie spelen daarin een steeds belangrijkere rol. Als Data Engineer krijg je de kans om vanaf de basis mee te bouwen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze data-infrastructuur en datagedreven informatievoorziening. Je maakt onderdeel uit van een compact en multidisciplinair NAZL-team, waarin verschillende expertises samenkomen. Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met de Projectleider Informatie & Data en met collega's die zich bezighouden met programma’s en projecten op het gebied van acute zorg, RCO of infectiepreventie & antimicrobiële resistentie.. Daarnaast heb je veel contact met data- en IT-professionals binnen de aangesloten zorgorganisaties en met landelijke samenwerkingspartners. De functie is breed: je bent enerzijds technisch bezig met datastromen, ETL-processen, SQL, datamodellen en datakwaliteit, en anderzijds werk je samen met collega's en zorgprofessionals om te bepalen hoe data het beste kan worden ontsloten en toegepast. Je ziet daardoor direct waarvoor je technische oplossingen worden gebruikt. Jouw werk vormt de basis voor onder andere ROAZ-beelden, dashboards en andere informatieproducten die worden ingezet voor de acute zorg in Limburg. Omdat het dataplatform van NAZL volop in ontwikkeling is, is er veel ruimte om mee te denken en zelf initiatief te nemen. Je krijgt niet alleen de opdracht om bestaande datastromen te beheren, maar denkt actief mee over standaarden, automatisering, architectuur en de verdere professionalisering van het platform. Ook vinden we het belangrijk om kennis te delen. Je krijgt daarom de ruimte om een netwerk op te bouwen met data engineers en IT-professionals binnen de regio en samen te werken aan toekomstbestendige oplossingen. Wat vragen wij van jou? Opleiding & Ervaring HBO- of WO-opleiding in (Klinische) Informatica, Data Engineering, Informatiekunde, Business & IT Management of een gerelateerd veld. Minimaal 3-5 jaar ervaring als Data Engineer, ETL-ontwikkelaar of in een vergelijkbare rol, bij voorkeur in de zorgsector. Technische Kennis Uitgebreide kennis van SQL (complexe queries, optimalisatie, stored procedures). Ervaring met Power BI (datamodellering, DAX, publiceren/beheer van rapporten). Ervaring met API-koppelingen (tussen systemen zoals kennisplatformen en dataplatforms). Kennis van ETL-tools (bijv. SSIS, Azure Data Factory of vergelijkbaar). Basisbegrip van datamodellering (bijv. ster-schema’s, 3NF). Pré: Ervaring met Azure (SQL Database, Synapse) of andere cloud-omgevingen. Pré: Kennis van zorgdata (bijv. DBC’s, ROAZ, EPD-systemen). Pré: Ervaring met Python of R voor datatransformatie. Pré: Ervaring met veilige datatransfer in geïsoleerde omgevingen (bijv. SFTP, gesloten netwerken). Persoonlijke Vaardigheden Analytisch vermogen: Jij ziet patronen in data en vertaalt deze naar praktische oplossingen. Proactief en oplossingsgericht: Jij signaleert knelpunten en stelt verbeteringen voor. Samenwerkingsgerichte instelling: Jij werkt graag met collega’s uit zorg, IT en management. Leergierig: Jij staat open voor nieuwe tools en methoden (bijv. CI/CD, datagovernance). Ons Aanbod Een uitdagende en afwisselende baan in de acute zorg in Limburg, waar je direct impact maakt. Ruimte voor eigen initiatief en de mogelijkheid om mee te denken over de toekomst van NAZL. Samenwerking met toonaangevende zorginstellingen in Limburg. Toegang tot unieke datasets (o.a. landelijke trauma registratie, capaciteitsdata) Hybride werken (thuis/kantoor) met flexibele arbeidsvoorwaarden Salaris Afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring bedraagt het salaris minimaal € 3.724,- en maximaal € 5.867,- bruto per maand bij een fulltime aanstelling. Dit salaris is exclusief vakantiegeld en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris. Arbeidsovereenkomst Het betreft een arbeidsovereenkomst van 1 jaar voor gemiddeld 32-36 uur per week conform artikel 2.4.2 Cao umc, zijnde een tijdelijk contract vooruitlopend op een arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd als bedoeld in lid 3 van artikel 2.3 Cao umc. Wat bieden wij Bij het Maastricht UMC+ zorgen wij ervoor dat je alles hebt om jouw bijdrage te leveren aan de ultieme zorg. Daar horen de juiste arbeidsvoorwaarden bij. Lees hier wat wij je bieden. Heb je nog vragen? Voor meer informatie over de functie of de opleidings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden mag je contact opnemen met Roel van Reij, bereikbaar via 043-3876389 of via info@nazl.nl. Voor informatie over de sollicitatieprocedure volg je deze link. Algemene informatie over arbeidsvoorwaarden en werken bij het Maastricht UMC+ vind je hier. Het antwoord op jouw vraag niet kunnen vinden? Neem dan contact op met team Recruitment. De sollicitatiegesprekken zullen in week 45 worden gehouden. Sollicitaties voor deze vacature kunnen worden ingediend tot en met 28 oktober. Wij werven onze kandidaten zelf en werken niet samen met externe bureaus voor deze vacature.

review_candidates.title: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer (m/w/d)
review_candidates.description: Benötigtes Sprachniveau: Deutsch Grundkenntnisse (B2), Englisch Fortgeschritten (C1) Arbeitszeit: Voll-/Teilzeit Das erwartet dich Als Senior Fullstack Entwickler:in spielst du eine Schlüsselrolle in unseren Produktteams, die das JobRad®-Ökosystem entwickeln – Die besten Lösungen für das Dienstradleasing. Du arbeitest in einem agilen, cross-funktionalen Team und bist eng mit unseren Entwickler:innen und Designer:innen abgestimmt, um eine nahtlose Integration sicherzustellen. Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf die User Experience und den Erfolg unserer digitalen Produkte, die nachhaltige Mobilität fördern. Dabei setzen wir konsequent auf AI-gestützte Entwicklung: KI-Assistenten und moderne AI-Tools sind fester Bestandteil unseres Entwicklungsalltags – vom Coding über Code-Reviews bis hin zum Testing. Deine Aufgaben Entwicklung und Optimierung fachlicher Anforderungen in modernen Webanwendungen mit React, TypeScript und Redux Toolkit sowie Backendanwendungen auf Basis von Kotlin, Spring Boot und Python Integration von APIs und Verarbeitung von eventbasierten Datenflüssen mit Kafka Entwicklung und Implementierung robuster APIs, die sowohl unsere Frontend- als auch Backend-Systeme nahtlos miteinander verbinden Enwicklung moderner Datenbanksystemen wie PostgreSQL oder MongoDB und Sicherstellung, dass datenintensive Prozesse effizient ablaufen Sicherstellung hoher Code-Qualität durch Clean Code, Wiederverwendbarkeit und Testbarkeit, kombiniert mit einem strategischen Ansatz für technisches Schuldmanagement und effektive MVP-Umsetzung Effizienter Einsatz AI-gestützter Entwicklungstools entlang des gesamten Workflows sowie Automatisierung wiederkehrender Aufgaben Weiterentwicklung und Etablierung von Best Practices für den verantwortungsvollen und produktiven Einsatz von AI im Team Aktive Teilnahme an Code-Reviews und Sicherstellung der Code-Qualität im Release-Prozess Pflege von Dokumentationen und technischen Konzepten Verantwortung für den vollständigen Lebenszyklus deiner Lösungen – von Konzeption und Entwicklung über Testing bis hin zum Deployment und der langfristigen Wartung Tausche dich regelmäßig mit Kolleg:innen aus und unterstütze dabei, unsere agile Arbeitsweise kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Das bringst du mit Du besitzt mindestens 7 Jahre Erfahrung in der modernen Softwareentwicklung (idealerweise im SaaS-Umfeld) und bist sowohl im Frontend- als auch im Backend-Umfeld zu Hause. Sehr gute Kenntnisse in unserem Tech-Stack: Frontend: React, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Node.js Backend: Kotlin, Spring Boot Daten: PostgreSQL, MongoDB Eventbasierte Datenflüsse: Kafka Sicherer Umgang mit CI/CD-Prozessen, automatisiertem Testing (Unit-, Integrations- und End-to-End-Tests) und Entwicklungsworkflows Erfahrung mit der Gestaltung, Integration und Nutzung von APIs sowie deren Optimierung Erfahrung mit Cloud-Infrastruktur im produktiven Betrieb (AWS bevorzugt, GCP/Azure ebenfalls relevant) Fundierte Praxiserfahrung mit modernen AI-Tools im Entwicklungsprozess (z. B. Claude Code, OpenCode, LiteLLM) für Code-Generierung, -Reviews, Refactoring und Testing Sicherer Umgang mit Prompt Engineering und agentenbasierten Coding-Workflows Arbeitsweise: Du bist proaktiv, eigenverantwortlich und qualitätsbewusst. Du arbeitest gerne im Team, teilst dein Wissen und bist stets bemüht, dich und deine Projekte kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Wir bieten dir Gestalte mit uns die Mobilität von morgen – in einer Kultur, die von zwischenmenschlichem Interesse, Offenheit und Respekt lebt. Bei uns zählen deine Ideen und wer du bist. Wir bieten dir Raum zum Entfalten, ein flexibles Arbeitsumfeld und sinnvolle Benefits. Wachse in einem vielfältigen Miteinander, in dem Mitgestaltung und Austausch wirklich gelebt und gewünscht werden.

review_candidates.title: Principal Software Engineer, AI DevOps
review_candidates.description: Location: Lisbon, Portugal / Krakow, Poland Working Pattern: Fully Remote (Portugal); Hybrid (Poland) Join our AI Delivery & Engineering team and provide principal-level technical leadership for AI delivery, release engineering and operational readiness. You'll help ensure reusable AI assets and enterprise solutions are reliable and reproducible. Impact You'll Own Define DevOps standards for reusable AI assets and the solutions using them. Strengthen delivery quality through reviews of supplier pipelines, infrastructure and deployment evidence. Guide decisions on environment strategy, automation, reliability, security, lead time and cost. Improve release traceability, artifact integrity, recovery and operational readiness. Advance reproducible delivery through controlled promotion, versioning and policy gates. What You'll Do Define standards for CI/CD, infrastructure as code, isolated environments and controlled promotion. Review supplier pipelines, infrastructure configurations, environment controls and deployment evidence. Guide partners on AI delivery patterns, automation trade-offs and approved asset reuse. Set expectations for version traceability across code, models, prompts, data, tools and runtime environments. Review artifact integrity, dependency controls, secrets management and evaluation gates. Assess rollback, safe fallback, recovery, observability, alerting and support handover evidence. Turn findings, evaluation results and incidents into improved standards and reference patterns. Skills And Capabilities Must-haves Degree in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering or a related discipline. Enterprise software engineering experience in cloud-native and distributed systems. Hands-on enterprise AI engineering and AI release lifecycle experience. Deep knowledge of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, release engineering and SRE practices. Experience with isolated environments, promotion controls and configuration versioning. Knowledge of model, prompt, data, retrieval, tool, asset and runtime traceability. Experience with artifact integrity, secrets management, policy gates and regression evidence. Knowledge of AI workload observability, availability, latency, cost, SLIs and SLOs. Proven technical leadership through standards, reviews, supplier assurance and remediation. Strong communication, cross-team influence, mentoring and documentation skills. Nice-to-have Advanced study in AI/ML, distributed systems or cloud/platform engineering. Rewards and Benefits Permanent local contract with a competitive salary plus Tabaqueira employee benefits including: Life and Health insurance Employee Pension Plan 26 holiday days National and international growth opportunities Diverse and international work environment For Poland: In this position, you will earn no less than 327660 PLN gross per year. 34555

review_candidates.title: Ingénieur(e) en Développement Backend - Spatial - Toulouse
review_candidates.description: Description De L'entreprise CS, filiale du groupe Sopra Steria, est un acteur technologique de référence dans la conception, l’intégration et l’exploitation de systèmes critiques. Présents dans 7 pays avec plus de 2 600 collaborateurs passionnés, nous intervenons au cœur des enjeux de souveraineté, de sécurité et de performance, dans des secteurs stratégiques tels que la défense, le spatial, l’énergie, l’industrie, le transport, l’aéronautique et la cybersécurité. Notre différence ? Une expertise unique en systèmes temps réel, des solutions souveraines et durables, et une culture d’innovation forte, portée par 15 % de notre chiffre d’affaires investi en R&D. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la réussite de leurs programmes les plus complexes, du contrôle aérien à la lutte anti-drones, en passant par les systèmes nucléaires et les centres de contrôle satellites. En rejoignant CS, vous intégrez une entreprise humaine et innovante. Nous livrons bien plus que des systèmes, nous bâtissons la confiance. Nous allons au-delà des besoins exprimés, nous préparons les défis de demain. Plus que de simples experts, nous façonnons l’innovation. Explorer, observer, sécuriser l’espace de demain. Avec 50 ans d’expertise, notre Business Unit Espace est un partenaire de confiance des agences spatiales, maîtres d’œuvre et opérateurs de satellites à travers l’Europe. Forte d'un savoir-faire reconnu, elle contribue activement à renforcer la performance, la sécurité et l’innovation de l’écosystème spatial. Nos équipes apportent leur expertise sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des missions : observation de la Terre, systèmes de navigation et de télécommunication, sciences et exploration interplanétaire, surveillance et sécurité de l’Espace. Portées par l’IA et nos solutions souveraines, nous repoussons chaque jour les frontières technologiques des programmes spatiaux européens. Rejoindre cette Business Unit , c’est façonner le futur de l’espace aux côtés d’experts passionnés. Description Du Poste Nous recrutons un Ingénieur(e) en développement backend pour rejoindre notre agence « Space Operations & Systems » spécialisée dans les métiers des segments sols satellites, la surveillance de l’Espace et la navigation par satellites. Vos missions En équipe intégrée sur l’un de nos projets en développement, vous participez aux activités suivantes : Analyse des besoins et conception technique et fonctionnelle, Développement du backend Rédaction de la documentation (design, manuel d’installation, etc.) Réalisation de tests L'environnement technique Back-end: Java, Spring, Springboot, Base de données : PostgreSQL, hasura Architectures : Microservices Devops : Jenkins, Kubernetes, Docker Qualifications De formation Bac+5 , vous justifiez de minimum 4 ans d’expérience dans le développement Java / Spring-boot et de la gestion des micro-services . La maitrise de Java et des services Web REST est impérative à l'exercice de vos fonctions. Vous avez une très bonne capacité d'analyse et de compréhension , vous êtes autonome , rigoureux ? Votre très bon sens du relationnel et de la communication vous permet de travailler efficacement en équipe afin de relever des défis ambitieux ? Alors vous êtes la pépite que nous recherchons ! Informations supplémentaires Rejoignez une entreprise où l’humain, l’innovation et l’impact se rencontrent. Chez CS, nous offrons : Une expérience collaborateur enrichissante, portée par un environnement de travail conçu pour favoriser la flexibilité, l’autonomie et le bien-être au quotidien. Un parcours d’intégration complet pensé pour embarquer chaque talent dès le premier jour et une Academy pour développer vos compétences, enrichir votre expertise et construire les parcours professionnels qui vous ressemblent. Un engagement sociétal fort : plus de 3 000 associations soutenues, une politique handicap active, une culture inclusive, une démarche de numérique responsable, et des partenariats comme Elles bougent pour inspirer les talents féminins de demain. …et bien d’autres avantages à découvrir en nous rejoignant ! Notre singularité ? L’alliance unique entre expertise technologique, projets critiques et engagement humain. Entreprise innovante et responsable, nous construisons un environnement éthique, inclusif et tourné vers l’avenir. Ouverts à tous les talents, nous croyons que la diversité est une richesse. La suite des évènements Si votre profil correspond, vous serez invité à un entretien technique avec l’un de nos Responsables opérationnels, pour échanger sur vos compétences et votre vision du métier. Vous rencontrerez ensuite Elodie ou Laura pour un moment d’échange autour de votre parcours, vos aspirations et notre culture d’entreprise. Enfin, parce que nous valorisons la transparence et le respect, nous nous engageons à vous faire un retour personnalisé par téléphone, quelle que soit l’issue du processus. #space #CSGROUP #java #hiring Employeur inclusif et engagé, notre société œuvre chaque jour pour lutter contre toute forme de discrimination et favoriser un environnement de travail respectueux. C’est pourquoi, attachés à la mixité et à la diversité, nous encourageons toutes les candidatures et tous les profils. https://www.soprasteria.fr/nous-connaitre/nos-engagements

review_candidates.title: Full Stack Engineer
review_candidates.description: Junior / Student Full Stack Developer Company: Hazol Location: Remote Company Description Hazol is a growing technology company focused on developing modern web applications and innovative digital solutions. We work with contemporary technologies and frameworks, emphasizing clean architecture, scalability, performance, and user-centered design. Our team values collaboration, continuous learning, independent thinking, and professional growth. We provide an environment where developers can gain hands-on experience, contribute to real-world products, and strengthen their technical skills. Role Description We are looking for a motivated Junior Full Stack Developer or Computer Science / Software Engineering Student to join our development team. This opportunity is ideal for students, recent graduates, and early-career developers who are passionate about technology and eager to gain practical experience working on real-world applications. Responsibilities: Develop and maintain modern web applications. Build responsive user interfaces using modern frontend frameworks. Develop backend services and integrate REST APIs. Work with databases, cloud services, and third-party integrations. Debug issues, optimize performance, and improve existing functionality. Write clean, maintainable, and scalable code. Collaborate with developers and contribute to technical discussions. Learn and apply modern software engineering practices. Qualifications Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Basic knowledge of at least one of the following technologies: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Angular, Node.js, Python, PHP, or Java. Familiarity with databases such as MySQL, Firebase, or MongoDB is an advantage. Familiarity with REST APIs and Git is an advantage. Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills. Ability to learn independently and adapt to new technologies. Good communication and teamwork skills. Motivation, responsibility, and a willingness to grow professionally. No previous professional experience is required. Why Join Hazol? Work on real-world applications and production projects. Gain hands-on experience with modern development technologies. Expand your technical knowledge across frontend, backend, databases, and cloud services. Enjoy a flexible remote working environment. Grow professionally while contributing to meaningful digital products. We welcome applications from motivated students and junior developers who are ready to take the next step in their software development careers.
